A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (22 January 2023). Its words are Decipher's errata from the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998) with one change: it reads “Adds X to your total power at that system” where Decipher has “Adds X to total power of your starships at that system”.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-deathsquadron-PC-Errata-D-E1-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Death Squadron (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels: sharper art and frame, lore and game text set again, and the mark “D-E1” in place of “E”. Same game text.

The whole 2018 image and the whole D-E1 image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
